angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 862,668 km at 317.14 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.1532 +/- 0.0327 mas (same row, RUWE 1.69): 317.14 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 1.24 +/- 0.13 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-22 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 862,668 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.46 +/- 0.63 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-22 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6000 +/- 100 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-22 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-22 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-22.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.416, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-22 (pscomppars): spectral type G1 V, from Maxted et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010AJ....140.2007M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-22 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.05 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-22 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.245, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-22 (pscomppars): age 3 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-22 (pscomppars): rotation period 16 d, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-22 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.5 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
